name: libbitcask
description: S37-4: Windows/MSVC dependency manifest. Carries only zlib -- the single dependency that is neither a git submodule nor buildable from the tree. Everything else (oneTBB, googletest, benchmark, utf8proc, cppjieba, limonp, unordered_dense) is a pinned submodule, so those revisions stay the single source of truth. NOTE: oneTBB is deliberately NOT taken from vcpkg -- the vcpkg tbb port pulls in hwloc, which drags an msys2 (m4/perl/autotools) toolchain into the build. This project builds pure-MSVC; oneTBB compiles fine from third_party/oneTBB with MSVC + CMake alone.
